open_points.subject: A19-1 Required tests
open_points.text: Witness, A19-1, A19-2: the test evidence of `_render_owner_page`, which renders every page of the owner interface [witness: note:_render_owner_page].
open_points.question: What must `_render_owner_page` show to establish A19-1 for every stored-value kind and every rendering context, rather than merely render every page?
options: Exercise every stored-value field in every HTML context with context-breaking values and assert that the response contains only the corresponding text.
Define a smaller exhaustive set of rendering primitives or contexts and require the check to prove that every owner-interface rendering passes through them.
Narrow A19-1 to the specific stored fields and contexts exercised by Required tests 1 and 2.
open_points.default_guess: Require an exhaustive set of rendering contexts and prove that every stored-value rendering uses one of them with the appropriate contextual escaping.

open_points.subject: A19-2 Required tests
open_points.text: Witness, A19-2: for a value with a quote and a semicolon that is stored and read back as it was given, never as part of a command, the test evidence of `create_project` [witness: note:create_project].
open_points.question: What must the Required tests show to establish “no stored value is ever evaluated or executed” beyond one `create_project` value and one command-shaped payload?
options: Require evidence for every interpreted sink named by rule 3—query, command, identifier, operator and syntax—and for import data under rule 4.
Require a boundary-wide proof that all caller and import values pass only through fixed data-value interfaces, with representative hostile values for each interface.
Narrow A19-2 to command construction by `create_project`, leaving the other guarantees as separate invariants with their own tests.
open_points.default_guess: Keep the universal invariant and require evidence covering every stated interpreted sink plus the import path.

open_points.subject: A13/A21 owner-session cookie guarantee
open_points.text:
the session cookie's attributes are now one
constant of the data provider, `OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES`, with the
same attributes as before.
open_points.question: What exact attributes does the constant contain, especially whether `Secure` is unconditional? A13 permits the cookie to be sent only over HTTPS when the interface is reached from another machine, while A21 also says “the session cookie is always HTTPS-only.”
options: Set `Secure` unconditionally and require HTTPS for every owner-interface session, including local access.
Make `Secure` conditional on the interface being reached from another machine, preserving local HTTP access allowed by A13.
Define separate fixed cookie policies for local and remote deployments while preserving HttpOnly and Registry-only scope in both.
open_points.default_guess: Set `Secure` unconditionally and require HTTPS everywhere, then amend A13 so its required outcome agrees.

witness.initial: The owner opens a local Registry owner interface over plain HTTP and has no existing owner session.
events: The owner submits the correct owner credential.
Registry creates the owner session and emits its cookie.
The browser makes the next owner-interface request over the same plain-HTTP origin.
outcomes: Under A13's conditional HTTPS wording, the browser may return the cookie and the owner remains signed in.
Under A21's “always HTTPS-only” guarantee, the cookie is not usable on the plain-HTTP request and the owner is asked to sign in again.
witness.observer: The owner using the local interface

open_points.subject: OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES value path
open_points.text:
the session cookie's attributes are now one
constant of the data provider, `OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES`, with the
same attributes as before.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The passage must name this code-read policy value as `the imported OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES constant`, rather than merely calling it a data-provider constant.

open_points.subject: OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES consumer
open_points.text:
the session cookie's attributes are now one
constant of the data provider, `OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES`, with the
same attributes as before.
open_points.question: Which generated module imports and applies `OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES` when it emits the owner-session cookie?
options: The owner-session/sign-in module imports and applies the constant directly.
A shared HTTP cookie-response module imports and applies the constant for the sign-in module.
open_points.default_guess: Have the module that emits the owner-session cookie import and apply the constant directly.
consequences: A direct import keeps the policy dependency local but duplicates cookie handling if another owner-session response later emits the cookie.
A shared response module centralizes cookie handling but makes that module the enforcement boundary and requires callers to use it consistently.
open_points.requirement:
The owner signs in with the owner credential (R0-30) and receives an owner
   session (M11), carried by a cookie that scripts cannot read, sent only over
   HTTPS when the interface is reached from another machine (R0-29), and only
   to Registry's own origin.
